en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view showing a large castle complex on a wooded hill to the left and a city with church towers and a river valley to the right. The title in red Gothic-style script at the top mentions Heidelberg and its castle, describing the view from a terrace. There is a large blank area at the bottom reserved for writing. Along the left edge in small red text is the publisher information.
